verdict.rationale: Several functions available in the Customer Area UI are also exposed through APIs. Refunds can be issued from the Customer Area or via the Terminal API. The Management API lets you order terminals by API request "instead of the Customer Area." The Disputes API covers retrieving, defending and accepting disputes, and Adyen publishes OpenAPI definitions and an official MCP server. However, no evidence states that every UI action has an API equivalent, so parity is only shown feature by feature. Missing for 10: an explicit statement or demonstration of full UI-to-API parity, API coverage for other Customer Area functions such as payout settings and terminal configuration, and independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
